engagements.name: Airline Reservations Platform
engagements.summary: Modern front end that replaces a legacy reservation system for call-center agents.
highlights: Led the federal excise tax module end to end, covering domestic ancillary purchases such as unaccompanied-minor fees, mileage purchases and bundles.
Led the digital menus feature that lets agents personalize meals for upcoming flights.
Led an onshore/offshore team from analysis to release, plus production support.

engagements.name: Airline Fare Automation Platform
engagements.summary: Self-service fare calculation based on industry fare standards, with faster and more accurate responses.
highlights: Queried S3 Parquet data with DuckDB and rendered it in AG-Grid.
Added real-time notifications with SignalR, plus event-driven AWS workflows.
Reached 90% Angular code coverage behind SonarQube quality gates.

engagements.name: Telecom Platform Modernization
engagements.summary: Brought an acquired brand's app into the provider's central IT platform for scalability, security and efficiency.
highlights: Built a micro-frontend architecture of independently deployable apps with Webpack Module Federation.
Integrated GraphQL APIs and Magnolia CMS content.

engagements.name: Telecom Customer Self-Service Portal
engagements.summary: Portal where customers check usage and billing, change plans, chat and shop.
highlights: Integrated AEM components with Angular components.
Built a Hapi.js backend-for-frontend that shapes external REST data for the UI.
Ran code reviews for the front-end team.

engagements.name: Venue Booking App
engagements.summary: Ticket booking for programs at the company's technology center.
highlights: Built individual and group booking with calendar time slots, QR codes and a My Bookings view.
Added multilingual support and consent-management integration.

engagements.name: B2B Account Portal
engagements.summary: Self-service portal where business customers manage user profiles, billing, payments and orders.
highlights: Produced high- and low-level designs, prototypes and design reviews.
Built accessibility-compliant pages and supported the go-live plan.
Turned static HTML into dynamic sites with Magento, WordPress and CodeIgniter.
Tested and deployed code to Apache and Nginx web servers.
Built core libraries for mailer template generation and search.
Made the home module faster and more reliable.
Developed web applications with CodeIgniter and MySQL.
